# 12. Integer to Roman

## Solution 1

```python
class Solution(object):
    def intToRoman(self, num):
        """
        :type num: int
        :rtype: str
        """
        nums = [1000, 900, 500, 400, 100, 90, 50, 40, 10, 9, 5, 4, 1]
        strings = ["M", "CM", "D", "CD", "C", "XC", "L", "XL", "X", "IX", "V",
                   "IV", "I"]
        ans = ""
        for i in range(len(nums)):
            while num >= nums[i]:
                ans += strings[i]
                num -= nums[i]
        return ans
```
